title: Mango cake near Guildford or Pendle Hill? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Mango cake near Guildford or Pendle Hill, with no eggs in it? Harris Park makes one, fresh to order.

Mango is one of our 15 flavours, and the whole range is 100% eggless. Not the sponge, not the cream, not the filling. Which is why a family that doesn't eat eggs can order without asking a single question.

A 6-inch starts at $39.99 and serves 6–8. An 8-inch is $49.99 and serves 12–14. Pick it up from Wigram Street, open daily 11am to 10pm. Harris Park station is a short walk.

Custom cakes need 2 days' notice. That's not slow. That's fresh to order.
